measurementRule: Semantic accuracy denominators include only unique cases that returned a valid structured result. API/quota failures are reported separately.

sameFormat.availabilityNote: 8 cases returned HTTP 429 before a structured result.

differentFormat.unmeasuredReason: u08 raster-only scan returned HTTP 503 twice; no structured result.
differentFormat.timingMetricExcluded: u03 raw result contains a clock anomaly, so per-case latency was not aggregated.

notes: GSA 3025 returned AI_RESPONSE_INVALID twice and remains unmeasured.
SF 1449 extracted all 14 fields but was labelled PURCHASE_ORDER instead of the strict CONTRACT target.

crossDocumentMismatchResults.excludedSuite: real-public-v1 uses one document per case, so cross-document mismatch is not applicable.

limitations: Each measured case has one successful run; repeatability and confidence intervals were not measured.
Public-form fixtures use public layouts with synthetic known values, not live company transactions.
Authenticity, fabrication, and document manipulation detection are outside the measured scope and require human or external verification.
API/quota errors are availability outcomes, not semantic extraction errors.
shortImprovementDirections: Repeat each representative case 10 times and report mean and worst-case accuracy.
Capture GSA 3025 invalid raw response shape and add an explicit schema validation/repair path without hiding the error.
Define a multi-purpose form type rubric or multi-label policy for SF 1449 before retesting.
Rerun the eight quota-blocked cases and the raster-only scan under fixed quota and unchanged fixtures.
